protocols.title: Visual Parsing
protocols.description: The DOM is captured and rendered headlessly. Computer vision algorithms identify visual hierarchy, contrast ratios, and structural balance, flagging areas of cognitive overload or illegibility.

protocols.title: Interaction Mapping
protocols.description: Simulated user journeys traverse the interface to measure time-to-task completion, hit-area sizing, and feedback loop latency. Identifies dead clicks and frustration vectors.
